name: cascade-simulations
description: Compile actors, manage versioned campaigns, execute bounded goal-directed simulations through Codex-host tools, and review frozen runs against fixed contracts.

interface.longDescription: Consume source-bound or explicitly synthetic projections from Cascade Personas; compile actors, domain briefs, observable outcomes, and reusable Codex-host adapters; run bounded journaled actor loops with declared dynamic state; and review frozen runs against their fixed actor, interface, authority, outcome, evidence, and limit contracts.
defaultPrompt: Simulate a real user completing this workflow.
Compile an actor, brief, outcome, or adapter from a validated persona projection.
Manage or execute an approved simulation campaign and review its frozen run.
